notes.title: Update 0.3 Released
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

This update has been a long time coming, so I'm pleased to say it's been released. The original plan was to release the contents of this big update in smaller releases, but when I looked at the way the mechanics worked together, I knew I had to implement these features at the same time. 

Here is the list of changes and new content:



 Added Apartments: This is the main hub where you can access the computer or do other activities. You can get a nicer apartment in the upgrades section of the Computer.
 Added Rent: The apartments cost rent every 15 days. You can see the amount due and how any days until the amount is due on the top right corner of the screen.
 Added Time: There's now a clock. A day starts at 8am and ends at 12am. As you do things, time will progress. This makes your actions more thoughtful as you try to manage efficiently.  
 Added Needs: Along with Stamina, you now have Hunger and Hygiene. These are needs that will go down when you preform certain tasks. You'll want to keep your needs high, so you can perform well with a Client.
 A Client's Foreplay level is increased by 30% when your Hygiene is low.
 During an appointment, your Stamina level is decreased by 30% when your Hunger is low.
 Added Food: You can go to the store and buy food. That food will be in your Apartment where you can fill the Hunger and Stamina needs.
 Added Gym: You can visit the Gym where Exercise will improve your overall Stamina.
 Added Hotel: Instead of instantly jumping to an appointment when you choose a job, you can now select an appointment at any time of the day. Then, you can go to your appointment at 8pm or later by traveling to the Hotel.
 

There's a lot that happens outside of appointments that will satisfy your Clients. Managing your time and needs is key to performing well in the sheets. 

There's still more work to be done. I'm looking at additions and balancing changes for this new content. A well as the next update, which will focus on the card game area of Clientele.

I hope you enjoy the new additions! You can reach me here on the forums or on Twitter.

notes.title: v0.3 Progress Update
notes.content:
Happy New Year!

Now that the holidays are over, I've been working on new content for Clientele. This update will be a huge addition. The biggest change will be the addition of apartments. You'll start will a small apartment, but can get a better apartment as you gain more money. Apartments will charge rent, so nicer apartments will cost more upfront and through rent. 

Another addition will be time. As you do certain activities, time will progress. This is how rent will be applied and appointments will actually be appointments at a certain time of day. This adds another level of management for the game, as good time management will greatly improve your character's performance in the bedroom.

Needs are coming to the game. Between appointments, you'll have to maintain your own needs like eating and sleeping. If you go into an appointment with low needs, your stamina will be lower, which will make it more challenging to satisfy your Client, and you won't earn as much money.

To satisfy those needs, new events will be added to the game. You'll be able to sleep in your apartment. Be mindful that this will progress time. You'll be able to go to a shop and buy food that can be eaten in the kitchen. 

Other events won't satisfy needs, but will satisfy skills. For example, you'll be able to exercise and increase your stamina. Better apartments will have better ways to increase these skills, which is why it will be important to upgrade apartments.


I don't have a timeline when this update will be released because there are still details to work out, and it's generally a big update. If you're enjoying the game, leaving a review would be helpful and If you have any questions or bugs to report, join the Steam Discussions and let me know!

notes.title: Update 0.2 Out Now
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

This update covers some fixes and additions that I wanted to take care of before I start adding Apartments and other major content in the next updates. Let me know in the Steam Discussions if you find bugs and I'll patch them out quickly.


Change Log

Added 100 more cards mainly designed for the late game.
Changed a few early game cards to balance out the initial battles. 
Added mouse drag to navigate the Card Shop. It's a faster way to scroll through the cards.
Added filters to the Card Shop that let you see owned, unowned, and cards in your deck separately. 
 Add arrow buttons to the Card Shop that let you jump to the top or the bottom of the page quickly.

notes.title: Roadmap
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 

With Clientele’s release coming upon us quickly on September 6th, I wanted to share my plans for the development of the game. So, here is the feature list of things I want to add to the game during Early Access. Some of these features are still ideas and haven’t been fully fleshed out yet, so the concept may remain the same, but the execution may change when it’s been added to the game. Also, I’ve made this list without the help of you guys because the game hasn’t been released yet. I’m fully anticipating developing Clientele with player feedback in mind. Essentially, the features added to the game might be different from this list depending on feedback and what will actually work gameplay-wise. Thanks for checking out Clientele!


 More cards
 More Clients
 Player owned Apartments
 New currency that unlocks special cards
 Time progression
 Sleeping
 Expand business managment
 Hire Employees
 Player needs that will give bonus to player stats
 Objective based story appointments
 Steam achievements
